name: cavemio-onboarding-checklist
title: Onboarding checklist
description: The first five things, ticked off in place: a ring that fills, checks that draw, and a finish worth seeing.

cavemio.accessibility:
- An ordered list of disclosure buttons, each with aria-expanded; done tasks say so to screen readers. Progress is announced politely ("3 of 5 done") and once more when all is done.
- The action button stays focusable while it runs and is marked aria-busy; a rejected promise leaves the task open to try again.
- Folded parts are inert, so the keyboard never lands inside them.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph. With reduced motion, ticks, strikes and the finish change in place without the burst.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: tasks
props.description: – · id, title, and any of description, done (controlled), and action { label, pendingLabel?, onClick? (return a promise to show progress), href? }.

props.name: title / doneTitle / doneDescription
props.description: "Get started" / "You’re all set" / … · The heading before and after, and the line shown once everything’s done.

props.name: onTaskComplete
props.description: – · Called when a task’s action resolves; mark it done here if you control done.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: – · Shows Hide once everything is done.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: false · Start folded to the header.

features.title: The next task is open
features.description: It shows what the task is, why it matters and the one button that does it.

features.title: Actions run in place
features.description: onClick can return a promise. The button shows a spinner and a pending label, and a failure leaves the task open to try again.

features.title: Progress is visible
features.description: A ring fills a step at a time and “2 of 5” rolls.

features.title: Finished tasks can be revisited
features.description: Click any row to open it, done or not.

features.title: Progress survives a reload
features.description: Pass done from your database, and mark tasks done as their actions land with onTaskComplete.

features.title: A finish worth seeing
features.description: The list folds away, the ring becomes a check with a small burst, and the title reads “You’re all set”.

states.title: next
states.description: The first open task is expanded with its description and action, on a soft tint.

states.title: doing
states.description: A spinner opens in the button and its label morphs to pendingLabel while your promise runs.

states.title: ticked
states.description: The ring blurs into a filled circle and its check draws (380ms); a strike draws through the label (480ms); this task folds and the next opens (420ms). The ring advances and the count rolls.

states.title: picked
states.description: Clicking any row opens it, done or not; finishing a task returns to the next open one.

states.title: folded
states.description: The chevron folds the list to the header, which keeps the ring and count.

states.title: done
states.description: The list folds, the ring fills and a primary disc grows over it with a check drawing itself, ten dots burst outward (700ms), the title morphs to doneTitle and Hide fades in.
